name: Brewer's Trade
summary: In Hillsbrad, a case of Fallrook Varietal is bound for Dun Garok. The brew-kin there miss the Fallrook family's vineyards, and a sack of Homebrew Hops comes back in trade.

sections.title: A Taste of the Past
sections.body: The Fallrook cellars still hold cases of wine, though most of its best bottled years are long gone. The Dun Garok brew-kin miss the family's vineyards too, and a trade has been arranged with them.

sections.title: The Exchange at Dun Garok
sections.body: You carry the case southeast to Dun Garok, where the brew-kin gather beside the fireplace at the base of their fort. In return, you bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

faq.q: What is being traded in this exchange?
faq.answer: A case of Fallrook Varietal wine from the cellars goes to the Dun Garok brew-kin in return for a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

faq.q: Where in Dun Garok does the wine need to go?
faq.answer: You leave the wine with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, at the base of their fort.
Dun Garok lies in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Fallrooks were a family whose vineyards are missed. Most of their best bottled years have long since been drunk, though cases of their wine remain in the cellars.
